Chapter 524: Chapter 17 The Galaxy Master Arrives (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 524: Chapter 17 The Galaxy Master Arrives (Subscription Request)_2

“`

“Have the reinforcements not appeared yet?” The Six-Winged Elder was also carefully observing the field, on guard for an Eighth Layer Invincible from the humans that could appear at any moment.

Whoosh~

An intangible breath descended, congregating above the battlefield, where the force of the black and white Yin-Yang Taiji coalesced into the tall figure of Lin Yuan. His gaze was profound and indifferent. Merely standing there, he began to influence the surrounding space.

“Hmm?”

The Six-Winged Elder sensed the anomaly immediately, and he looked up at Lin Yuan with an extremely solemn expression.

...

“The Galaxy Master.”

“Galaxy Master, you’ve finally taken action.”

The Baiyun Lord also looked towards Lin Yuan, and his hanging heart finally settled down.

“The Galaxy Master is here?”

“The Galaxy Master has finally arrived.”

“We’re too useless, we didn’t even force out Tianyu Clan’s trump card, and the Galaxy Master was forced to take action.”

Each and every one of the human Eighth Layer Invincibles brimmed with excitement. After all, the Galaxy Master was too powerful: not yet a hundred years old and already at the Eighth Layer, having comprehended three types of high-level cosmic forces, and further having slain two Eighth Layer Invincible beings from a Different Species.

In the history of human civilization, no Eighth Rank Evolver had emerged as powerful as Lin Yuan. A progeny of a Supreme Being might be able to kill other Eighth Layer Invincible beings at the Eighth Rank.

But that would be with the aid of treasures bestowed by a Supreme Being!

But what about the Galaxy Master?

He had just one Eighth Layer Invincible tutor, the Chikun Starlord.

The Chikun Starlord’s disciple indeed counted as significant backing for other Seventh and Eighth Rank Evolvers, but what was that to other Eighth Layer Invincible human Evolvers?

The Galaxy Master had reached where he was today almost all on his own.

“The Galaxy Master?!”

The Six-Winged Elder was equally strained. Even when the think tank of the Tianyu Clan had predicted the situation, they mentioned the possibility of the Galaxy Master’s appearance.

But when faced with such a legendary Eighth Layer Invincible, the Six-Winged Elder still felt immense pressure.

This was the Galaxy Master.

He broke the myth of the Eighth Layer Invincibles, raising the ceiling for the Eighth Layer Invincibles.

In the think tank’s assessment of the Galaxy Master, they determined that his chances of stepping into the Ninth Rank exceeded ninety percent.

What did ninety percent signify? It was nearly the same as directly stating that the Galaxy Master was certain to ascend to the Ninth Rank.

Human civilization, with its vast population, was generally far less talented than the Tianyu Clan, yet it had produced such an anomalous genius, making the unparalleled talents within the Tianyu Clan seem dim and lackluster.

“Why can’t I lock onto the Galaxy Master’s position, even though he’s standing there, it’s as if he’s in the depths of infinite spatial layers, visible but untouchable?”

The Six-Winged Elder’s eyebrows twitched. He stared intently at Lin Yuan, only to find that the Lin Yuan he saw seemed unreal, like a flower in a mirror or the moon reflected on the water.

…

Hum…..

The moment Lin Yuan appeared, vast spatial fluctuations enveloped the area in all directions.

Under these spatial fluctuations, the ripples of space exerted by the Six-Winged Elder began to collapse, and the human Eighth Layer Invincibles, who had been suppressed in speed, found themselves freed from suppression.

Zoom.

The Baiyun Lord likewise broke free from the constraint, turning around to return to the side of the human Eighth Layer Invincibles.

After the arrival of the Galaxy Master, the highest command authority over the human civilization Evolvers on the battlefield had transferred from the Baiyun Lord to the Galaxy Master.

“It broke my trump card so effortlessly?”

The Six-Winged Elder’s expression was grave. His space ripple technique, a move he realized from the depths of his bloodline and combined with his own mastery of cosmic force, was terrifyingly powerful.

With only a slight effort, it suppressed the Baiyun Lord, an experienced Eighth Layer Invincible, but before the Galaxy Master, it seemed as fragile as thin paper.

“The Galaxy Master.”

The Six-Winged Elder did not retreat, believing that even if he was no match for the Galaxy Master, he would not easily be killed by him.

Compared to those two Eighth Layer Invincibles who died at the hands of the Galaxy Master, the Six-Winged Elder, who came from one of the Peak Clans, possessed more life-saving means, and the cosmic force he had comprehended was also high-level.

Lin Yuan looked at the Six-Winged Elder with a smile, “It’s been quite some time since I’ve taken action. I hope the treasures you carry have some value; otherwise, killing you would be somewhat dull.”

Upon hearing this,

The Six-Winged Elder’s face turned ugly, “Galaxy Master, are you so certain you can kill me?”

Both were Eighth Layer Invincibles, and even if the Galaxy Master had mastered three types of high-level cosmic forces, he too had mastered one type of high-level cosmic force.

“`

“`

And delving deeply into his own bloodline, he had also comprehended a multitude of killing moves.

Did the Galaxy Master really consider him as one of those ordinary Eighth Layer invincibles?

….

When the Galaxy Master appeared, it not only caught the attention of human Eighth Layer invincible evolvers.

The many strong members of the Tianyu Clan were also quietly tensing up.

“Galaxy Master? Is this not the one heralded as the first invincible of the Eighth Layer in the history of human civilization?”

“I wonder what mysteries lie within the three higher cosmic forces he holds.”

“Should we attack now?”

“Haven’t you seen the leader hasn’t given an order?”

“The leader probably wants to test the Galaxy Master’s strength and then devise a plan to decide how many Eighth Layer invincibles are needed to hold off the Galaxy Master.”

One by one, the Eighth Layer invincibles of the Tianyu Clan stopped attacking and stood their ground to watch.

Even if they knew that the Galaxy Master possessed the combat power to kill Eighth Layer invincibles, they did not believe that the Six-Winged Elder would encounter any trouble at the hands of the Galaxy Master.

At worst, he would suffer a bit and be suppressed for a while.

This would also provide a better assessment of the Galaxy Master’s strength.

…

The Six-Winged Elder felt aggrieved in his heart as he stared fixedly at Lin Yuan: “Since the Galaxy Master is so confident, I won’t hold back any longer. This space secret treasure, containing the complete Space Rules, was refined by one of our clan’s powerful Ninth Rank beings.”

“I want to see, with this treasure protecting me, just how you, the Galaxy Master, plan to kill me.”

The Six-Winged Elder raised his right hand, and a silver-white cube floated in the air, slowly rotating.

He had gone all out, too; such a space secret treasure would normally be a last resort, but facing the Galaxy Master, the Six-Winged Elder had no desire to hide it, as he would use it right from the start.

“Not bad at all.”

“Your Tianyu Clan, quite generous.”

Lin Yuan watched the silver-white cube in the hands of the Six-Winged Elder and nodded slightly.

This treasure, although not a Ninth-tier Secret Treasure, was worth just as much, containing the Complete Space Rules not just as a weapon but also allowing its possessor to comprehend them.

“Go.”

The Six-Winged Elder activated the silver-white cube, and space around it began to fluctuate once more, with strands of space power turning into a spatial tempest that swept towards Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan watched quietly.

With the silver-white cube, the Six-Winged Elder’s strength was enough to suppress ordinary Eighth Layer invincibles, as the cube was an ‘external force’, equivalent to a Ninth-tier Secret Treasure.

Lin Yuan looked at the rapidly approaching spatial fluctuations, and with a mere thought, the violent space power began to calm down, the silver-white cube included, which stopped rotating and fell silent.

“What?” The Six-Winged Elder couldn’t believe it. The Galaxy Master’s mastery over space was even greater than his when wielding the silver-white cube?

“With my understanding of space, combined with this space secret treasure, how could anyone suppress me so completely in the field of space?”

The Six-Winged Elder could not accept what was happening before his eyes.

“Unless…..”

The Six-Winged Elder looked toward Lin Yuan, a preposterous thought suddenly emerging in his mind.

Unless Lin Yuan had completely pierced through the Complete Space Rules, only then could someone so overwhelmingly dominate him in the realm of space,

The silver-white cube indeed contained the Complete Space Rules, but after all, it was only a weapon, a lifeless object, and when facing someone who had fully comprehended the Complete Space Rules, it was naturally restrained.

“Die.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Six-Winged Elder, whose expression had turned fearful, and, without wanting to waste words, waved his hand lightly.

An invisible force pierced through the void, and the Six-Winged Elder’s form stiffened, rapidly crumbling to dust.

The silver-white cube and the space bracelet fell and appeared in Lin Yuan’s hand.

The force fused with the Complete Space Rules and many cosmic forces was something the Six-Winged Elder could not begin to resist.

On the side of the Tianyu Clan, the numerous Eighth Layer invincible strong members fell silent; they had originally planned to see how many killing moves the Six-Winged Elder might force out of the Galaxy Master.

But in the end, did the Galaxy Master just need to swing his sleeve, and the Six-Winged Elder was shattered?

“This power…”

In the high altitudes of the battlefield, within another layer of space, the Ninth Rank individuals of the Tianyu Clan, who had been casually observing the battle, saw Lin Yuan’s move and their expressions changed slightly, revealing shock.
